EmailTemplate.name: New Applicant GRNH Grad
EmailTemplate.subject: Incomplete admission application follow-up
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for submitting your application to the College of Health Solutions at Arizona State University. Once your file is complete, our admission committee will review your file and communicate a decision within three weeks.
You may review details about the status of your application in My ASU and also verify receipt of your supplemental materials such as transcripts and letters of recommendation.
Please reply to this email to let me know when we might expect to receive your remaining application materials so I can make a note in your file for the admission committee.
If you need more details about the program or the admission process, please do not hesitate to call or email me directly. Thank you again for your application. I look forward to working with you throughout the admission process.
Sincerely,
{!User.Email}
{!Case.Thread_Id}
